combat_rules.damage_formula: final_damage = (base_damage + scaling_attribute_value * attribute_scaling) * rank_multiplier * buffs * target_mitigation
combat_rules.cooldown_rule: Cooldown begins after successful skill activation unless a skill explicitly defines another rule.
combat_rules.resource_rule: Validate resource cost before casting; deduct only after activation succeeds.
combat_rules.rank_rule: Rank 1 is the learned baseline. Each rank applies the skill's rank_scaling values.
combat_rules.server_authority: In multiplayer, validate damage, cooldowns, resources, summons, and status effects on the authoritative server.

effect_resolver_notes.direct_damage: Apply damage using damage_type and scaling fields.
effect_resolver_notes.healing: Resolve target eligibility and max-HP percentage.
effect_resolver_notes.buff: Apply stat_modifiers for duration_seconds, then remove them.
effect_resolver_notes.crowd_control: Apply control effect with duration and resistance checks.
effect_resolver_notes.summon: Spawn the configured summon and enforce max_active_summons.
effect_resolver_notes.movement: Perform movement after collision and navigation validation.
effect_resolver_notes.defense: Apply absorption or mitigation and expire it after duration.
effect_resolver_notes.execute: Check target HP threshold and apply bonus damage; do not guarantee instant kills on bosses.
